segments.title: Technical Difficulties & Pre-Show Banter
segments.notes: Case troubleshoots OBS performance, Photoshop resource usage, and missing producer Jake; discusses computer upgrades, Kendall's PC issues, and philosophical musings on simulation theory.

segments.title: Gaza Ceasefire Collapse with the Devil
segments.notes: The Devil interrupts the broadcast to discuss Israel resuming military strikes on Gaza, killing 410+; reads Netanyahu's statement; debates dehumanization rhetoric; refuses to help; mentions Pepito drinking Jolt Cola.

segments.title: Movie Trailer Watch Party
segments.notes: Case and chat watch trailers for Ballerina (John Wick spinoff), Assassin's Creed Shadows (two trailers), Windows XP Media Center (tribute to Kendall), and Happy Gilmore 2; discussion of historical accuracy, diversity complaints, and Sandler's Netflix deals.

segments.title: Kendelle's Resignation Announcement
segments.notes: Kendelle reveals she has put in two weeks' notice at her job; Case and chat discuss freelance negotiation, unlimited PTO implications, and potential SpaceX employment jokes.

segments.title: Ant Species Deathmatch: Chimera vs. Jiju
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate which fictional ant species would win: Hunter x Hunter's Chimera Ants vs. Solo Leveling's Jiju Ants; Crum defends Chimera Ants, Munch argues for Jiju Ants; Crum wins $5,000 toward his $160,000 gorilla debt.

segments.title: JFK Files Release: 80,000 Pages of Nothing
segments.notes: Chet (as Big Cheddar) covers Trump's release of JFK assassination records; Tom Semilac confirms no smoking gun, lone gunman conclusion stands; Case speculates on LBJ/RFK pants recordings; Grandman poll confusion.

segments.title: Male Grooming & Tantric Sex with Liliana
segments.notes: Liliana hosts as 'Lily Oral-Breathingschmidt' with Jeb's Dad trapped in wood; tutorials on male eyeliner (JD Vance application), chest hair clippers, and tantric sex featuring Sting; ChetAI triggered by 'science' keyword.

segments.title: Musical News Wrap-Up & Yogi Bear Freestyle
segments.notes: DJ Newsic delivers auto-tuned news rap over Tantric EDM: Twitch viewbotting scandal, Mitch McConnell strategic brilliance chants, Jonathan Majors confession, Pope Francis health, segregated facilities rollback, wood-chewing brain boost; Yogi Bear appears as crack-addicted snorting bear.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell navigated a technically troubled broadcast featuring the Devil's commentary on Gaza, a marathon trailer watch party, Kendelle's job resignation announcement, a high-stakes ant-species debate that paid down Crum's gorilla debt, Chet's JFK files breakdown revealing no new conspiracies, and Liliana's chaotic How To session on male eyeliner and tantric sex before DJ Newsic closed with a musical news rap and a crack-addicted Yogi Bear freestyle.
